listing.name: Virtua Cop — virtuacop (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: The project reaches boot, attract mode, coin/start and a playable first-person stage. Stage completion is unverified, and sound is entirely unimplemented. The main game CPU runs as native C; coprocessors remain emulated. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own vcop/vcopa ROM set including CPU-board math tables opr-14742a.45 and opr-14743a.46. rom_loader produces program/data/polygon/texture/coproc images; generated game C is local and not distributed.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract ROM images with rom_loader.py, generate game C with i960_lifter.py and build vcop.exe with CMake, SDL2 and vcpkg. The runtime reads the resulting ROM-image folder. The reviewed README does not establish a ready-to-run player archive.

warnings: The project reaches boot, attract mode, coin/start and a playable first-person stage. Stage completion is unverified, and sound is entirely unimplemented. The main game CPU runs as native C; coprocessors remain emulated.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
